name: Tek — with a Swamp and a Mountain: +2/+0 and first strike only
notes: Partial sweep (single cards, 2026-10-12). "gets +0/+2 as long as you control a Plains, has flying as long as you control an Island, gets +2/+0 as long as you control a Swamp, has first strike as long as you control a Mountain, and has trample as long as you control a Forest." Two of the five items were unread, and the Plains condition gated the whole line. Each item now has its own condition: 4/2 with first strike, no flying, no trample.
